context: Ren returns to visit Tatsuya-country years later; tearful reunion.
purpose: Adult son-figure returning to elder mentor.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おじさん、お久しぶりです!
lines.style: Warm, slightly breathless greeting. Voice rises gently on 'Uncle.' Genuine pleasure underneath. Nervous energy of reunion—careful, respectful.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Low, steady voice. Pride settling into the words like a weight that fits. Pauses before 'fine'—considering the whole of the young man in front of him. No rushing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 故郷、変わらないですね。
lines.en: Hometown hasn't changed at all, has it.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering. Reverent quietness—not quite a question. Takes in the place around him. Breath held a moment, then released gently.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: お前、ようけ成長したな。
lines.style: Firm but warm observation. Slight emphasis on 'grown'—not physically, but as a person. Lean, direct. The kind of man who says what he sees without flourish.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I carry your kindness with me always.
lines.style: Quiet, careful gratitude. Each word distinct, spoken slowly. Slight tremor of sincerity underneath. No performance—just truth being said aloud carefully.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Simple statement, delivered as fact. Steady Tohoku drawl. Weight of meaning in 'family'—not said lightly. Warm but unadorned.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます、本当に。
lines.style: Soft, almost formal closing. Voice catches slightly—emotion present but controlled. Bows slightly into the words. Holds the silence after.
